Are you a chiropractor?  You're in the right place for chiropractic education and marketing tips!  Whether you've recently graduated chiropractic school, or you're a 'veteran' DC, we have high-quality information, tools, and resources to help your chiropractor marketing.

When considering starting your own chiropractic franchise, consider HealthSource® - America's Chiropractor.  We have more than 300 locations across 41 states.  Let’s face it, most DC’s live in a bubble, with very few people they can trust for relevant, proven, and affordable help to build an outstanding practice.  We're here to change that!

We’ll help you find a great location, negotiate a fair lease, design the floor plan, obtain the right equipment and furnishings, and everything else in between.  Then, after your grand opening, we'll make sure you know about the very best operating systems in chiropractic, so you'll have an efficient and profitable practice.

To learn more, visit: http://hsfranchising.com/
